metric.label: public contributions
metric.methodology: Daily public contribution count from GitHub's contribution calendar.

metric.label: active sessions
metric.methodology: Distinct Codex session files with an observed event on each local calendar day. Annual totals are active-session-days, not lifetime sessions or token usage.

metric.label: AI code events
metric.methodology: Unavailable until a first-party aggregate export can reproduce Cursor's AI Line Edits metric. Local request IDs are not treated as line edits.

cursor.source: Cursor AI Line Edits dashboard (aggregate export not configured)

metric.label: active sessions
metric.methodology: Distinct Claude Code session IDs with an observed event on each locally retained calendar day. Annual totals are active-session-days, not lifetime sessions.

claude-code.source: Local Claude Code session event timestamps

buildIndex.label: Build Index
buildIndex.formula: Equal-weight mean of each available provider's independently normalized daily level.
buildIndex.disclaimer: It describes observed activity breadth and intensity; it is not a productivity score.
